image.color_space: CMYK with the GRACoL2013_CRPC6 ICC profile; tiles are converted to sRGB
image.units: pixels of the original image; x grows to the right, y grows downward

source.title: The Great State of Leonida (Leonida Map & Cover Art Poster, printable)
source.attribution: Map © Rockstar Games. Official Leonida map, used for non-commercial fan reference.

tiles.note: Built by scripts/map/build-tiles.mjs. 512 px tiles, numbered on the 256 px reference so zoom 5 is full resolution: image pixel (x, y) is Leaflet point (x, y) at zoom 5. 2x screens show each tile at 256 CSS px one level deeper (docs/MAP.md, Sharpness).

grid.measured_by: scripts/map/measure-grid.mjs (pixel analysis of grid lines and margin label glyphs), 2026-11-23
grid.cell_id: Row letter then column number, for example F5. Our notation; the poster prints letters down both sides and numbers across top and bottom.
grid.notes: Letters A to M label the 13 horizontal bands (rows, top to bottom); numbers 1 to 9 label the 9 vertical bands (columns, left to right). Interior cells are 600 px square; rows A and M are cut short by the frame (461 and 459 px), column 9 is 595 px. Letter order is inferred from glyph metrics (the ninth letter is a 6 px wide stroke, an I), not read by eye.

labels_note: Empty on purpose. Place labels must be read by a person from the image (docs/MAP.md, Recording labels): docs/LEGAL.md and docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md rule 5 forbid feeding the map into AI tools, so the map agent did not view the image.
